title: Hippos Ooze a Red Liquid. It Works as Sunscreen and Antibiotic

scenes.text: Hippos ooze what looks like blood. It isn't blood.
It's a red liquid from their skin, and people have called it blood sweat for centuries.
In 2004, Japanese chemists found two pigments in it, one red and one orange.
Both absorb ultraviolet light, so the liquid works like a sunscreen.
The red pigment also stops two kinds of disease-causing bacteria from growing.
A hippo makes its own sunscreen and its own antibiotic, right out of its skin.
